brief: A dense, mechanical scene shows a sturdy shredding apparatus positioned below a substantial stack of books. Visible within the gears and tearing plates are brass and dark metal components that are constantly turning and engaging. As books fall into the machinery, the gears visibly tear the paper, generating steam that vents from friction points. Fine dust and scattered pulp are suspended above the central mechanisms, while the metal surfaces show accumulated scorch marks and dark, solidified residue, reflecting the intense, continual act of mechanical destruction.
